description: This file defines the LeaveParameterObject class in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, representing a data transfer object (DTO) for leave parameters, including properties for employee ID, leave type, date range, comments, and leave durations, with input validation and helper methods.

classes.name: LeaveParameterObject
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating leave parameters such as employee ID, leave type, date range, partial leave options, and associated leave durations with validation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing leave parameter properties with employee number, leave type, start date, and end date.

methods.name: isMultiDayLeave
methods.description: Checks if the leave spans multiple days based on start and end dates.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee's unique identifier.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee's unique identifier.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type identifier.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type identifier.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave, with validation to ensure it is not earlier than the start date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves optional comment associated with the leave.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Assigns an optional comment to the leave.

methods.name: getSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Gets the duration of a single-day leave; throws exception if called for multi-day leave.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a single-day leave.

methods.name: getStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the starting duration for multi-day leave, validating partial option applicability.

methods.name: setStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Assigns the starting duration for multi-day leave, with validation.

methods.name: getEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the ending duration for multi-day leave, validating partial option applicability.

methods.name: setEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Assigns the ending duration for multi-day leave, with validation.

methods.name: getMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Returns the partial day option for multi-day leave; throws exception if called for single-day leave.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Sets the partial day option for multi-day leave, validating allowed options.
